links.outcome: Clinician workload, burnout, and documentation time after ambient scribe deployment, using validated instruments
links.effect: NASA-TLX fell from 74.64 to 51.94 (P=0.04); after-hours documentation fell from 3.6 to 0.75 h/week (P=0.02); Mini-Z rose from 2.5 to 2.83 (P=0.73, not significant).
links.quote: After DAX implementation, the NASA-TLX score decreased significantly to 51.94 (P = 0.04), and documentation time dropped to 0.75 hours per week (P = 0.02).

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating the real-world deployment of an ambient AI scribe (Dragon Ambient Experience) on plastic surgery residents' workload, burnout, and documentation time.
